notes.title: Now available on mobile devices!
notes.content:
Wish you could take young Nick of Nick Hall everywhere you go? Well too bad, because now you can! The Adventures of Nick & Willikins is now available for Android mobile devices. Along with the new release comes new features designed especially for the small screen.

- A brand new interface for touch screen interactions.
 -A “reveal hot spots” button to help eliminate the dreaded Pixel Hunt!
 -Non cursor based inventory handling!​

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.PinheadGames.NickAndWillikins
